_comment: H6320 template of the live /root/.config/backrest/config.json on vps92 (backrest v1.14.1). Placeholders in <...>. Secrets are NOT committed: UI credentials live in /root/.backrest-ui-credentials (0600), the restic password is passed via RESTIC_PASSWORD_FILE env, never inline. NOTE: auth.users[].passwordBcrypt must be base64 of the ASCII $2b$ bcrypt hash (backrest base64-decodes it before bcrypt-compare). Do not schedule Backrest check over append-only SFTP: its exclusive lock persists and blocks hourly backups.
